name: Cosdarica de Shimo Zhong zhi Lü Tu
original_name: 科斯达丽佳的世末终之旅途
source:
Human civilization had finally burned out its last spark. The survivors chose to gather together, shutting themselves within safe zones to await death. But Cosdarica did not. Neither did I.
